author: Tarhuala
tagline: Web novels about hostile systems and the people stuck inside them
bio: I write web novels about ordinary people dropped into systems that were not built for them. They get fired, or transported somewhere worse, then spend the rest of the story learning the rules before the rules finish them. I still work a nine to five, so updates come when they come.

seo.title: Tarhuala · Horror & System Fiction Web Novels
seo.descriptionOverride: Tarhuala writes horror and system-fiction web novels. Six ongoing series, free to read online.
